verses.translation: Moreover do thou take up a lamentation for the prince of Israel,

translations.ron: Iar tu, fiul omului, fă o tânguire pentru căpeteniile lui Israel şi spune:
translations.grk: Καὶ σὺ λάβε θρῆνον ἐπὶ τὸν ἄρχοντα τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ,

verses.translation: and say, Why is thy mother become a whelp in the midst of lions? in the midst of lions she has multiplied her whelps.

translations.ron: "Ce este mama ta? O leoaică! Ea a dormit între lei şi între puii de leu şi-a alăptat puii săi.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐρεῖς, τί ἡ μήτηρ σου σκύμνος ἐν μέσῳ λεόντων ἐγενήθη; ἐν μέσῳ λεόντων ἐπλήθυεν σκύμνους αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: And one of her whelps sprang forth; he became a lion, and learned to take prey, he devoured men.

translations.ron: A crescut pe unul din puii săi, care s-a făcut leu, şi a învăţat să sfâşie prada, şi a mâncat oameni.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπεπήδησεν εἷς τῶν σκύμνων αὐτῆς, λέων ἐγένετο, καὶ ἔμαθε τοῦ ἁρπάζειν ἁρπάγματα, ἀνθρώπους ἔφαγε.

verses.translation: And the nations heard a report of him; he was caught in their pit, and they brought him into the land of Egypt in chains.

translations.ron: Şi auzind popoarele de dânsul, a fost prins în groapa lor şi l-au adus în lanţuri în ţara Egiptului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἤκουσαν κατʼ αὐτοῦ ἔθνη, ἐν τῇ διαφθορᾷ αὐτῶν συνελήφθη, καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν ἐν κημῷ εἰς γῆν Αἰγύπτου.

verses.translation: And she saw that he was driven away from her, and her hope of him perished, and she took another of her whelps; she made him a lion.

translations.ron: Aşteptând leoaica puţin timp şi văzând că aşteptarea sa este zadarnică, a luat pe altul din puii săi şi l-a făcut leu.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶδεν ὅτι ἀπῶσται ἀπʼ αὐτῆς, ἀπώλετο ἡ ὑπόστασις αὐτῆς· καὶ ἔλαβεν ἄλλον ἐκ τῶν σκύμνων αὐτῆς· λέοντα ἔταξεν αὐτὸν.

verses.translation: And he went up and down in the midst of lions, he became a lion, and learned to take prey, he devoured men.

translations.ron: Acesta, făcându-se leu, a început să umble printre lei şi a învăţat să sfâşie prada şi a mâncat oameni;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνεστρέφετο ἐν μέσῳ λεόντων, λέων ἐγένετο, καὶ ἔμαθεν ἁρπάζειν ἁρπάγματα, ἀνθρώπους ἔφαγε,

verses.translation: And he prowled in his boldness and laid waste their cities, and made the land desolate, and the fulness of it, by the voice of his roaring.

translations.ron: A atacat casele lor şi le-a pustiit cetăţile; şi de larma răgetului lui, ţara şi locuitorii ei s-au îngrozit şi s-a pustiit ţara şi toate satele ei.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐνέμετο τῷ θράσει αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰς πόλεις αὐτῶν ἐξηρήμωσε, καὶ ἠφάνισε γῆν, καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς ἀπὸ φωνῆς ὠρυώματος αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: Then the nations set upon him from the countries round about, and they spread their nets upon him: he was taken in their pit.

translations.ron: Atunci s-au sculat împotriva lui neamurile din ţinuturile vecine, şi-au întins cursele lor împotriva lui şi el a fost prins în groapa lor;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκαν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ἔθνη ἐκ χωρῶν κυκλόθεν, καὶ ἐξεπέτασαν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν δίκτυα αὐτῶν, ἐν διαφθορᾷ αὐτῶν συνελήφθη·

verses.translation: And they put him in chains and in a cage, and he came to the king of Babylon; and he cast him into prison, that his voice should not be heard on the mountains of Israel.

translations.ron: Atunci l-au pus în lanţuri într-o cuşcă şi l-au dus la regele Babilonului; apoi l-au vârât într-o cetate, ca să nu se mai audă glasul lui prin munţii lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔθεντο αὐτὸν ἐν κημῷ καὶ ἐν γαλεάγρᾳ, ἦλθε πρὸς βασιλέα Βαβυλῶνος, καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὸν εἰς φυλακὴν, ὅπως μὴ ἀκουσθῇ ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: Thy mother was as a vine and as a blossom on a pomegranate tree, planted by water: her fruit and her shoots abounded by reason of much water.

translations.ron: Mama ta a fost ca o viţă de vie, răsădită lângă apă; rămuroasă şi roditoare a fost ea din pricina belşugului de apă.
translations.grk: Ἡ μήτηρ σου ὡς ἄμπελος καὶ ὡς ἄνθος ἐν ῥοᾷ, ἐν ὕδατι πεφυτευμένη, ὁ καρπὸς αὐτῆς καὶ ὁ βλαστὸς αὐτῆς ἐγένετο ἐξ ὕδατος πολλοῦ.

verses.translation: And she became a rod for a tribe of princes, and was elevated in her bulk in the midst of other trees, and she saw her bulk in the multitude of her branches.

translations.ron: Şi ea avea coarde tari, pentru sceptre regale, şi şi-a ridicat trunchiul său sus printre ramuri dese şi atrăgea privirile cu înălţimea ei şi mulţimea ramurilor ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο αὕτη ῥάβδος ἐπὶ φυλὴν ἡγουμένων, καὶ ὑψώθη τῷ μεγέθει αὐτῆς ἐν μέσῳ στελεχῶν· καὶ εἶδε τὸ μέγεθος αὐτῆς ἐν πλήθει κλημάτων αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: But she was broken down in wrath, she was cast upon the ground, and the east wind dried up her choice branches: vengeance came upon them, and the rod of her strength was withered; fire consumed it.

translations.ron: Dar a fost ruptă cu mânie şi aruncată la pământ, vântul de răsărit a uscat rodul ei; ramurile ei cele puternice au fost rupte, s-au uscat şi le-a mistuit focul.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατεκλάσθη ἐν θυμῷ, ἐπὶ γῆν ἐῤῥίφη, καὶ ἄνεμος ὁ καύσων ἐξήρανε τὰ ἐκλεκτὰ αὐτῆς· ἐξεδικήθησαν, καὶ ἐξηράνθη ἡ ῥάβδος ἰσχύος αὐτῆς· πῦρ ἀνήλωσεν αὐτήν.

verses.translation: And now they have planted her in the wilderness, in a dry land.

translations.ron: Iar acum ea a fost sădită în pustiu, într-un pământ sec şi însetat.
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν πεφύτευκαν αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ ἠρημῳ, ἐν γῇ ἀνύδρῳ.

verses.translation: And fire is gone out of a rod of her choice boughs, and has devoured her; and there was no rod of strength in her. Her race is become a parable of lamentation, and it shall be for a lamentation.

translations.ron: Din trunchiul ce poartă ramurile ei a ieşit foc, a mistuit rodul ei şi nu au mai rămas în ea coarde puternice pentru sceptrele regale. Aceasta este cântare de jale şi de jale va rămâne".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξῆλθε πῦρ ἐκ ῥάβδου ἐκλεκτῶν αὐτῆς, καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτὴν, καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἐν αὐτῇ ῥάβδος ἰσχύος· φυλὴ εἰς παραβολὴν θρήνου ἐστὶ, καὶ ἐσται εἰς θρῆνον.
